name: AlphaCopy_PS
summary: Copies a layer's alpha into the effect alpha target: writes (0, 0, 0, source alpha).

members.name: source
members.text: The layer's own target, sampled at uv clamped to row 37.zw.

name: FullscreenTriangle_VS
summary: Vertex shader of the alpha copy: an oversized triangle built from the vertex index, so no vertex buffer is bound.

behavior.text: built from SV_VertexID (the pass binds no vertex buffer; the shader reads row 11.xy as a uv scale).

name: LayerBlendNormal_PS
summary: The layer blit pixel shader for blend type 0 (normal), offset variant 0: composites one layer's premultiplied pixels over the frame target by a read-modify-write of an unsigned-normalised UAV. It is the first of the 36 layer-blend pixel shaders (18 blend types x 2 offset variants) of selector #9; the blend arithmetic is in the shader, not in the fixed-function blend state.

members.name: SV_Position
members.text: The pixel being written; its integer part addresses the UAV.

members.name: cUIRender
members.text: Row 34.zw = atlas offset / target size (added to the uv); rows 9 / 10 = colour multiply / add of the layer; row 8.z = brightness factor on rgb; rows 15, 18-19, 28-30 and 20-27 = the clip / distance-mask groups (off for a plain layer).

members.name: layer
members.text: The layer's pixels (premultiplied RGBA); read through g_Sampler, which holds the default word (point), at the integer atlas offset, so the read is the texel.

members.name: mask source
members.text: Second source, sampled only when the clip group (row 15.w) is on; alpha scales the result.

members.name: target
members.text: The frame target (typed UNORM UAV), read and written in place.

behavior.text: S = sample(t0, uv + cb34.zw) x cb9 + cb10 per channel (rgba, premultiplied): with the default layer constants (multiply 1, add 0) S is the layer pixel.
the clip / distance-mask groups (row 15.w, row 20.x and rows 24-27) only scale S further when enabled; a plain layer takes none of those branches.
S.rgb is multiplied by cb8.z (1.0 in the Job Tree: the float at UI manager + 144, live read 1.0); S.a is not.
when S.rgb x cb8.z and S.a are all exactly 0 the pixel is left alone (no load, no store).
otherwise D = load(u0 at the pixel) and store(u0) = (D.rgb x (1 - S.a) + S.rgb x cb8.z, D.a x (1 - S.a) + S.a), a premultiplied 'over' in float, written to an 8-bit UNORM UAV.

this is the pixel shader of selector #9 with digit 0 = 0 (blend type, GUILayer_BlitFinal) and digit 1 = 0 (no offset vectors): the 36 shaders at 0x006E60 .. 0x031B80 pair up as 3-sample / 5-sample variants, blend type k = shaders 2k and 2k + 1; blend type 2 (0x00BB20) computes a multiply (rgb = dst x (S + 1 - S.a)). Basis: the shader family layout and the arithmetic; the permutation table of the technique file was not parsed.

notes: Blend type 0 is the type every Job Tree layer reads except the name tag Lv boards (type 2, multiply) and one layer with type 7 on the screen that was running when this was read.
open_questions: ? the vertex shader paired with it; the file's permutation table (which digit varies fastest) was inferred from the shader order, not parsed.

name: LayerBlendNormalOffsets_PS
summary: Blend type 0 with the offset variant (digit 1 = 1): the same over composite as LayerBlendNormal_PS with extra samples at the layer's three offset vectors (selected when any of them is non-zero).

behavior.text: five samples instead of three, otherwise the same arithmetic as the offset-free shader (diff of the DXIL text of the pair 0x006E60 / 0x0080E8 not read line by line).

open_questions: ? the exact use of the three offset vectors (layer+120..+140).

name: LayerQuadOffset_VS
summary: Vertex shader of the drop-shadow pass: moves the layer quad by the shadow offset and keeps its texture coordinates.

members.name: cUIRender
members.text: Row 12.zw the shadow offset in pixels (added to the position); rows 4-7 the projection (x 2 / width - 1, y 1 - 2 / height; no half-pixel term).

behavior.text: output position = (position + offset) x projection; texcoord unchanged, so the texture is sampled at the pixel minus the offset.

name: LayerShadow_PS
summary: Drop-shadow pass of a UI layer: darkens the target in place under the layer's blurred alpha, before the layer itself is drawn.

members.name: cUIRender
members.text: Row 13.x strength, rows 31.xyz colour, 34.zw atlas offset / target size, 20.x distance-mask switch (off on the Job Tree).

members.name: g_Sampler
members.text: Not set by the pass: holds the default word, so the read is point-filtered.

members.name: target
members.text: The target under the layer, read and written in place (UNORM).

behavior.text: A = alpha of t0 at uv + atlas offset; s = saturate(strength x A); target.rgb = target.rgb x ((1 - s) + colour x A); target.a = s + target.a x (1 - s).
with the point read, 8-bit blurred alpha and the half-down UNORM store, the formula reproduces every changed value.

name: MaskComposite_PS
summary: Mask pass of a masked layer (the screen title): the layer's gradient times the mask buffer.

members.name: mask
members.text: Mask coverage in the red channel (register not recorded; RT 30 is the R8 target the mask pass reads).

name: UIImage_PS
summary: The plain UI image pixel shader (UI technique program 0): every textured UI image (discs, the selection ring, the cursor glove, plates, floor tiles, line parts).

members.name: tTexture0
members.text: The image's texture (straight alpha); its size and mip count are read in the shader.

members.name: g_Sampler
members.text: The draw's sampler word (0x2C0: bilinear, wrap).

behavior.text: footprint F = max over u and v of max(ddx, ddy) of the texel coordinate (coarse derivatives, SIGNED: a mirrored cell's u counts as 0).
when the texture has fewer than 2 mip levels and F > 2 (a pixel spans more than two texels) it takes four bilinear samples at +-0.5 texel in u and v and averages them; otherwise one sample.
every sample's alpha is remapped before averaging: a' = saturate(a x 1.0101009607315063 - 0.010101010091602802), i.e. (a - 0.01) / 0.99; colour is not remapped.
output = saturate(sample x vertex colour), premultiplied by the output alpha.

behavior.basis: (mid-frame capture 2026-10-30, the selection ring's own draw into its layer, 2.7 texels per pixel)
behavior.text: this fetch reproduces the draw to +-1 on 26 of 7700 values; a single bilinear sample misses by up to 24.

name: UIImage_VS
summary: Vertex shader of the UI image program: position (x, y, z, w) times the projection in constant rows 0..3; colour and texture coordinate passed through (no snapping).
